latest_release.name: v4.0.543
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed

- `@remotion/studio`: **Add audio level meters** by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13146
- **remotion.pro is retired, buy a license now at https://www.remotion.dev/pricing instead**
- [`@remotion/cli`: Add `open-timeline import` and `canvas-capture import`](https://remotion.dev/docs/cli/open-timeline/import) by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13148
- [`@remotion/renderer`: Add `chromiumOptions.flags` to override Chrome flags](https://remotion.dev/docs/options/chromium-flags) by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13147
- [`@remotion/renderer`: Add `proResBitsPerMacroblock` for ProRes file size control](https://remotion.dev/docs/options/prores-bits-per-macroblock) by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13220
- [`@remotion/studio`: Add movable playback diagnostics](https://remotion.dev/docs/options/show-diagnostics) by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13224
- `@remotion/studio`: Create `<Track>`s by right-clicking by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13289
- `remotion`: Fix `<HtmlInCanvas>` flicker when resizing by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13222
- `remotion`: Stop `<CanvasImage>` from reloading when `onError` is inline by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13238
- remotion.new: Install required auxiliary packages with Elements by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13154
- remotion.new: Pin transitive dependency versions in fallback bundle, avoid ephemeral e2e port by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13203
- `@remotion/cli`: Fix `remotion elements` errors and docs that disagree with the command by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13151
- `@remotion/cli`: Reload the config again when it changes during a reload by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13260
- `@remotion/lambda`: Fix process crashes on chunk file write errors by @anthod0 in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13170
- `@remotion/media`: Fix duplicate redraw after ready and apply volume on mount by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13196
- `@remotion/media`: Skip audio initialization when muted or disabled by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13221
- `@remotion/media`: Call `onError` once and show the error fallback when a preview fails by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13247
- `@remotion/player`: Fix audio interruptions from late preview frames by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12519
- `@remotion/player`: Reduce bundle size by 10% by sharing code between `remotion` and `remotion/no-react` by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13172
- `@remotion/player`: Fix buffering indicator not shown when buffering restarts within one frame by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13213
- `@remotion/renderer`: Fix replacement browser not closed after crash by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13188
- `@remotion/renderer`: Fix port lock not released when port selection throws by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13189
- `@remotion/renderer`: Fix CDP connection teardown running twice by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13190
- `@remotion/renderer`: Fix asset download hanging after invalid data URL by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13191
- `@remotion/skills`: Make Studio interactivity the default by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13133
- `@remotion/skills`: Use `.element.tsx` file names and full Element index links for agents by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13156
- `@remotion/studio`: Keep t
